topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I can't believe it. The tree... it's gone. All that growth, all those years of watching it get taller, its branches spreading wide under the sky like it was reaching out to hug the clouds. I remember planting it, the small sapling no bigger than my arm, my dad’s smile as we packed the earth around its roots. It was there, right outside my window, a silent companion through so many days and nights. Now, just an empty space. It’s like a piece of my childhood has just vanished. How do I find my way back to that spot and not see it? What am I supposed to do now?
